h1s: Beach Horse Rides, Campground and Farmstay accommodation in Golden Bay.
paragraphs: Located in beautiful Golden Bay, Hack Farm is an eco Farmstay and animal friendly Campground is just a short walk or ride from Patons Rock beach and serves as the perfect base for your next Horse Riding Holiday. We offer a number of holistic horse experiences from guided treks on our team of highly trained horses, to Vaulting, Horsemanship and Riding lessons or simply Bring your Own Horse and enjoy our easily accessible trails that will allow you to explore the beauty of the ever changing coastal landscape on horseback.
With great outdoor facilities and comfortable accommodation, our Camping, Farmstay and Backpacker options will guarantee a good night’s sleep after your day’s adventure.
Our horse riding experiences are suited for riders of all abilities. ‘Hacktivities’ range from 1h rides through to multi-day experiences – our rides are as fun as they are informative.
Horsemanship, Vaulting and Riding Lessons. Whether you’re new to riding, are looking to expand your knowledge we can equip you with tools you need.
Holistic Horse Experiences – learn while you ride

We offer riders of all experience levels opportunities to learn more about the foundations of good horsemanship whilst experiencing stunning coastal scenery on horseback. With a focus on teaching light and balanced riding, our guided holistic horse riding experiences are so much more than just a trail ride.
Our professionally guided horse treks provide a safe and fun environment to further your riding knowledge, build confidence and challenge yourself.
Fun and engaging vaulting sessions for all ages
Vaulting is often described as a combination of dancing and gymnastics on horseback and is considered to be the safest equestrian discipline.

We’ve seen time and time again how transformational the sense of confidence and self awareness gained by finding your balance and expression on horseback has on individuals of all ages and particularly for kids and Baerbel is passionate about sharing this magic with others.
No previous experience is required for this fun and engaging activity.
Comfortable accommodation options to guarantee a good night’s sleep after your day of exploring.
Enjoy a family & pet friendly environment in our 120 year old eco friendly farmhouse and horse ranch, or park up in one of our camping spaces!
Facilities include: Pizza Oven, Communal Kitchen, Showers, Rope Swing, Climbing Wall, Fruit Trees, Vegetable Garden and much much more.
Fun camps and riding days

Our Horse Club days are the perfect introduction to the foundations of communication with your horse both on the ground and in the saddle. We help riders of all ages find confidence around horses, both in the saddle and on the ground utilising Vaulting Experience, Horsemanship Lessons and Horse Rides all situated at our Hack Farm.
Bring your own horse and enjoy a holiday away

Our vision for Hack ‘n Stay has always been a getaway for you & your horse! With our guest paddocks, holding yards and arenas, we have everything you need to keep your horse comfortable while you enjoy a Horse Riding Holiday away together. Use our Hack Track to access Patons Rock Beach or even hire a guide to show you the best spots around.

accommodation.title: Accommodation | Hack n Stay Golden Bay
paragraphs: Accommodation options at Hack Farm
Hack farm has a number of eco friendly accommodation options designed to help you slow down, immerse yourself in nature and enjoy the simple things in life.
Enjoy a family & pet friendly environment in our 130 year old eco friendly farmhouse and horse ranch, or park up in one of our camping spaces!
Facilities include: Pizza Oven, Communal Kitchen, Showers, Rope Swing, Lake, Climbing Wall, Trails to the Beach, Fruit Trees, Vegetable Garden and much much more.
Comfortable ROoms in a historic farmhouse

Our funky horse inspired homestead is a traditional farmhouse and features a fully equipped Communal Kitchen, Outdoor Pizza Oven, Fireplace, Living Room and Dining Area. Guests love the welcoming and friendly communal vibe of the house. Wifi Available to house guests.
Check in is between 3pm and 7pm, Check out is by 11:30am.Early/Late Check-ins can be organized by arrangement.
Ask us about our long term stay options
A little bit of comfort after your day of exploring Golden Bay, our Green Foal Room is the perfect choice for a private night’s rest. In this lovely horse themed room. Minimum stay two nights.

Our bunkroom is located in our funky horse themed homestead. The perfect choice for a group of friends or the budget conscious traveler. Comfortable bunk beds give you the perfect place to rest your head after your day of adventures.

This 3x single-share room is a popular choice for friends travelling together. With funky art and a comfortable bed to rest your head, you’ll have plenty of opportunities to reminisce about your day’s adventures at Hack n Stay
Frequently Asked Homestead Questions

Definitely! Our property is dog friendly and we love having canine guests. You are responsible for your dog throughout your stay and we ask that you clean up after them and ensure polite interactions with other guests and animals.
Please keep your dog in the car until we have properly introduced them to our farm dog. Our farm dog MOE is territorial and needs to be on a leash for safety.
YES! We offer horse stays for just $10 per horse. Ride down to the beach, explore our trails or book in for a lesson on your very own horse.
Our house kitchen is fully equipped with the essentials like Coffee, Tea, Bread, Cereal and milk. However you’ll have to bring your own food for main meals and snacks.
We also highly recommend visiting the Historic Mussel Inn during your stay for a meal.

Yes, Wifi is available for houseguests but please note that we are on a slow copper connection.Wifi is suitable for planning your next adventure or general social media but not for watching movies/netflix.
Yes! We allow guests to stay with us for up to 60days and offer special weekly rates for stays over 30days.
Give us a call to discuss how we can make it work for you.

No, the farmhouse is a communal area used by all house guests. While your room will be private, the lounge, living room, dining area and kitchen are all shared facilities with other house guests.We often hear that the friendly communal vibes in the house are a highlight for our guests.
We love sharing our fresh produce but please always ask first before taking anything from our gardens.There are also a variety of fruit trees on the property that you are welcome to enjoy.
No, The farmhouse is a family friendly area and a completely smoke free zone for a minimum of 15m around the house as well. We ask that you respect this rule at all times.
All bedding is provided for your stay so no need to bring bedding.
Definitely! Just have a chat to Baerbel on or before arriving so we can take you through the lighting procedures for the pizza oven.
Yes, please enquire about availability. Only between February and December.
Sleep under the stars, wake up immersed in nature

Whether you’re camping in your car, pitching a tent or bringing your Caravan, our Dog Friendly campground nestled amongst the fruit trees has all the Facilities you need to have an enjoyable stay under the stars.
Check in is between 3pm and 7pm, Check out is by 11:30am.Early/Late Check-ins can be organized by arrangement.
Ask us about our long term stay options
Drive in and Park up for the night for just $26.50 per person over the age of 2.
Sleep under the stars in your tent for $26.50 per person over the age of 2.
One off payment per campsite - Winter power rates are higher
Frequently Asked Camping Questions

Definitely! Our property is dog friendly and we love having canine guests. You are responsible for your dog throughout your stay and we ask that you clean up after them and ensure polite interactions with other guests and animals.

If you are bringing your dog with you, please let Baerbel know at the time of booking and keep your dog in your vehicle until you have had a chance to introduce them to our farm dog Moe who can be a little territorial at times.
Yes! We supply 16amp power to your car or campervan for a one off set up fee of $10. Please note winter rates may apply.

Our camp kitchen equipped with portable electric stove, dish washing area, Some Cups, Plates and Cutlery and picnic benches. We Encourage you to bring your own cooking equipment in the peak saeason. We also have a fridge/freezer to keep your food cool while you’re out and about exploring.
Please make sure to clearly mark your food in the fridge.
Unfortunately Wifi is reserved for our house guests. Embrace the opportunity to immerse yourself in nature away from your devices. The nearest free wifi is at the Mussel Inn.
Yes! You can camp with us for a maximum of 60 days at any given time. For stays over a month long we have a special rate of $160/ week pp that includes free use of our laundry facilities.
Yes! all of the taps on site have potable water and you can fill up where ever you find a tap.
We have a washing machine available for use by our guests
We don’t offer any drying machines but we recommend hanging clothing up at your campsite or in the barn to dry.
Nope, Our showers are included as part of your stay for paying campers.
Children under the age of 2 can stay for free but we ask that you book a separate slot for each member of your party over the age of 2.
We offer the cheapest camping rates in Golden Bay so we don’t offer any additional discounts for children over 2.
Bring your own horse and enjoy a holiday away

Our vision for Hack ‘n Stay has always been a getaway for you & your horse! With our guest paddocks, holding yards and arenas, we have everything you need to keep your horse comfortable while you enjoy a Horse Riding Holiday away together. Use our Hack Track to access Patons Rock Beach or even hire a guide to show you the best spots around.
Holding Yard or Grazing accommodation for your horse which includes. Round pen, and covered arena usage. Hay or hard feed is extra (depending on the seasonal price)
Ride with one of our knowledgeable guides - figure out exactly where to go, hear stories of local history, culture and lore.
Frequently Asked BYO Horse Questions
Yes! We have plenty of space for floats to park on the property.
Our property has a 25m round yard, a covered 20x40m Arena, a cowboy challenge obstacle course, wash-down bays, hitching rails, paddocks and dry lot areas available for guest horses.
We are an actively working trekking business but all facilities are available to guest horse stays provided they’re not in use by our team.
Yes, while we do have grass paddocks available we do recommend bringing your own hay and hard feed.
If your horse is barefoot we do recommend bringing at least front boots with you. Although the beaches are soft there are quite a few rocky areas that can be tough on horses feet.

Using our Hack track you’ll have access to hours upon hours of riding along the coastline. Ride to the historic Mussel Inn, enjoy a beer and some munchies before riding home or explore the every changing Rangihaeata inlet. Swim your horse in our horse friendly dam and go for a full moon ride to see the constellations of glow-worms on our track.
Hack n Stay is dedicated to those who want to enjoy the simple things in life. Bring your own horse or enjoy time with one of ours in Beautiful Golden Bay.

rides.title: Holistic Horseback Experiences | Hack n Stay Golden Bay
rides.ogDesc: Guided Trail rides on horseback in Golden Bay NZ
h1s: Horse Riding Holidays with a difference
paragraphs: Guided Trail rides on horseback in Golden Bay NZ
Here at Hack n Stay, we’re passionate about sharing the magic of connected horse riding in Golden Bay. Whether you’re a complete beginner or an experienced rider, we have a horse trek suited to you!

We offer riders of all experience levels opportunities to learn more about the foundations of good horsemanship whilst experiencing stunning coastal scenery of Golden Bay on horseback. With a focus on teaching light and balanced riding, our guided holistic horse riding experiences are so much more than just a trail ride.
empowering – rebalancing – finessing

Our professionally guided horse treks provide and safe and fun environment to further your riding knowledge, build confidence and challenge yourself. Whether you’re looking for a Short Ride to sample the beauty of Golden Bay on horseback or an extended Full Day Ride to fully immerse yourself in the local culture, cuisine and stunning coastal scenery – we have a variety of options just for you!

Here at Hack n Stay we also offer Vaulting Lessons and Experiences for riders of all ages and abilities. If you’re interested in finding your balance, building your confidence and connecting with a horse in this unique manner check out our Vaulting Experiences.
Sample the beauty of Golden Bay on Horseback

Our short trail rides offer riders of all experience levels and ages the opportunity to learn about the magic of connected and balanced riding, whilst experiencing the beauty of Paton’s Rock Beach. We have options available for the whole family and cater rides for complete Beginners through to Experienced Riders.

The perfect introduction to balanced riding for riders of all ages, the Hack Track/Fairy Trail Loop is a 1h ride through our rolling farm country. Ride through native forests, with great views of the ocean and enough ups and downs to challenge new riders. This ride is only on farm and bushland. Suitable as an introduction to trail-riding
Our most popular ride for riders of all abilities. The Patons Rock Beach ride takes you through our famous Hack Track down to the beach where will you be able to explore the scenic coastal vistas.

There are few things quite as magical as splashing and playing with your horse in the ocean. Enjoy the scenic beauty of Golden bay as we ride down to Patons Rock Beach, untack and feel the waves flow underneath you as you ride in crystal clear water.Weather dependant

Our private or pro ride offers and exclusive experience for up to 3 people from family or friends. Enjoy a personal and flexible tour tailored to your interest and ability. Let our experienced guides and horses take you through the paces.

Our twilight rides take you through native forest and rolling farm country before hitting the beach and watching the sun paint the sky red as it sets behind the waves. If the conditions allow, you may even spot some glow-worms on your way back.
For the wellfare of our horses and due to the challenging terrain of our rides, Our weight limit for all rides is 90kg.
Depending on riding experience and fitness level we may make exceptions.
If you are over our weight limit, we do have a few alternatives that will still allow you to join us for a ride down along the flat section of the beach.

We don’t believe in age being a limiting factor for a horse ride. If you’re capable of sitting independently, our team of highly trained horses can take you for a ride. We’ve had riders as young as 2.5 and as mature as 92 and all have had a fantastic time in a safe environment.

We believe your horse experience with us is so much more than simply time in the saddle. All of our ride times include catching and getting to know your horses, brushing and feeding them as a thank you afterward. We find guests love the opportunity to bond with their horse and then further their connection in the saddle.

We recommend wearing comfortable long trousers (No zip-offs) and closed shoes. A loose long sleeve shirt is also a good idea to protect yourself against the harsh sun. If you’ve booked a swimming ride, bring your swimmers along too.

Our rides are catered to your individual abilities so even in mixed experience groups, we allow opportunities for controlled trots and occasional canters on the beach dependent on your guide’s confidence in your riding ability. Young riders ( under 16) do we only allow trotting. Parents joining appreciated

If you have a bigger group than availability allows, give us a call or flick us an email about your party. We’d love to accommodate your group and with some prior notice we will do our best to organize the guides and horses required for your ride.
Unfortunately not, your dog can hang out in one of our sheltered dog runs or shady places.
of course, we do have tea and coffee in the farmhouse
Yes, drive back to the Highway and turn left, next left and left again to 272 Patons Rock Road / Bydder Reserve.
You can spot the hoof prints in the sand. We will come out and back there the same way.

Immerse yourself in the splendour of the Tasman Region.

Perfect for experienced riders looking to make the most of their time on horseback, our full day horse treks combine the best of all worlds as we immerse you in the rich culture, history and stunning natural environment Golden Bay has to offer. From riding through ancient Kahikatea forests to riding through to the famous Mussel Inn for a beer and some local cuisine, these rides are the best way to really experience Golden Bay.

Rangihaeata is a beach – headland- estuary- esplanade – reserve ride. Wow- It will take you up to 4 hours and is a stunner regarding changing landscape, nature, birds and great beaches. We cross the Onahau River and come along Maori heritages. Stories to tell and memories to collect.

The Ale Trail is an interesting ride along the beach and past headlands with 2 river crossings. We can tie the horses up at the Mussel Inn hitching rail, we’ll shout you a drink and snack then ride on home before the next high tide.
Weather and tide dependent.
we can pick you up by car from the Mussel Inn – if it is to long or you’d rather have another home brew there 🙂

A stunningly good ride along the beach to the quaint village of Collingwood. Along the way we ride through unique art displays, rock formations and have plenty of opportunities to stretch our legs. Here we can visit the cafes, get a drink or a beer in the village before heading back via float or through the changing light of this wonderful tidal landscape. Just for experienced riders, tide and weather dependent.

A bespoke horse riding holiday, designed by you specifically for you.
So often we hear guests say that they wish they could have spent more time learning to connect with their horse and exploring wonders of Golden Bay’s Beaches on horseback.

We created a flexible package designed to help you create your own adventure around what you most want to get out of your time with us. Spend your day’s Vaulting, Riding or Learning Horsemanship with comfortable Accommodation in our homestead included.
additional day $450 (all prices incl. fees & taxes)
Frequently Asked Multiday Questions
In a nutshell, our multiday packages are loaded with incredible value, including comfortable accommodation in our homestead as well as 1 full day of horseback activities per Night.
This could either be 2 activities/lessons from our short ride section or one full day ride.

Activities are tide dependant, we create an itinerary for the group but it can be adjusted based on the riders experience levels and the weather. Have a chat to us about what you would like to do most during your stay.
This group activity is possible from February -December.
We can also help you put together the perfect complimentary local sightseeing itinerary on request.
Yes! We can cater for vegetarians & vegans as well. We provide 3 meals per day as well as all the essentials you might expect in a fully equipped kitchen- Coffee, Tea, Butter, milk, bread etc.

learning.title: Learning experiences | Hack n Stay Golden Bay
paragraphs: Vaulting, Riding, Horsemanship lessons

Here at Hack n Stay, we’re all about developing connections between horses and humans Both in the saddle and on the ground. By combining good horsemanship, Centered Riding and trust based leadership we’re passionate about building relationships between horses and their humans.
Balanced riding for all ages & Abilities

One of the things we often hear from our guests is a desire to learn more about our style of balanced riding. By combining Human & Horse Biomechanics, Centered Riding and Good horsemanship, our riding lessons will not only give you the confidence to have fun in the saddle but will teach you how to be an effective and ethical rider regardless of your chosen discipline.Whether you’re a new rider, returning to riding, or looking to renew your confidence in the saddle; our riding lessons will help you be the best rider you can be for your horse.

A fun and engaging way to learn how to communicate with your horse. Our Cowboy challenge obstacle course has a number of challenges designed to build your confidence in the saddle and help you become an effective rider. Obstacle course also has a number of difficulties making it suitable to challenge even experienced horsefolk.

We believe that there’s no better arena to learn how to ride than the golden mirrored sands of Paton’s Rock Beach. This experience starts at our farmhouse and follows our hack track down to the beach where we’ll split off from the ride for a one on one riding lesson.
The perfect introduction to centered riding, an arena riding lesson will help you find confidence in the saddle as you learn how to work with your horse to achieve balanced riding.

Connection, Intention, Leadership

Good Riding starts from the ground up. Our horsemanship lessons will help you become the leader your horse deserves as we teach you the fundamentals of communication with horses. Horsemanship lessons include Groundwork, Round Penning, Obstacle Courses, Communication and Trust Development.

Help your little one learn how to take care of horses. From Grooming, to leading to the saddling and more, these sessions serve as an introduction to horse ownership and will give your child confidence around horses and peace of mind for parents.

Learn how to communicate with your horse in a manner that they understand. Our Groundwork sessions will teach you the fundamentals of natural horsemanship and cover a range of skills to develop your knowledge, build trust with your horse and to become the leader your horse deserves.

Horsemanship is the language we use to communicate with horses. Through horsemanship we learn how to develop a partnership with our horse, building a mutual language we can both understand in order to get the most out of our time together.

Our horsemanship lessons all start on the ground as we find this is the best way to help you understand the importance of body language, intent and energy. That being said we believe in translating everything we do on the ground back into the saddle so you can always combine a horsemanship session with one of our rides to get the most out of your experience.

We recommend wearing comfortable long trousers (no zip-offs) and closed shoes. A loose long sleeve shirt is also a good idea to protect yourself against the harsh sun. If you’ve booked a swimming ride, bring your swimmers along too.

We believe in using the best tool for the job at hand and don’t prescribe to only one style of horsemanship. Over the years we’ve honed our toolbox and acquired new tools from a number of horsemanship practitioners.

Grace, Balance & rythm. Learn to fly with our exceptional vaulting experiences.
Vaulting is often described as a combination of dancing and gymnastics on horseback and is considered to be the safest equestrian discipline.

We’ve seen time and time again how transformational the sense of confidence and self awareness gained by finding your balance and expression on horseback has on individuals of all ages and particularly for kids and Baerbel is passionate about sharing this magic with others.
No previous experience is required for this fun and engaging activity.

Our Ride & Fly is the best combination of experiences. We start off at the homestead and ride down to beach over our farm track and through native forest as part of our Paton’s Rock Beach Ride. Once on the beach the fun really begins as we split from the group and teach you how to find balance, confidence and grace on horseback with a vaulting lesson on the water’s edge.

Utilising our purpose built vaulting arena we’ll introduce you to the magic of flying on horseback. Within no time we’ll have you standing on horseback, connecting with the rythm and motion of your horse like never before.

Yes, vaulting is actually considered to be the safest of all equestrian sports & is proven safer than riding bicycles, playing on playground equipment, and even playing soccer due to Vaulting’s 3 points of Safety.

Vaulting is suitable for riders of all ages and in fact we recommend riding in a vaulting saddle for riders under the age of 5. In no time at all your child will be flying up on the horses back as they find confidence, balance and freedom of movement.

We recommend wearing comfortable long trousers (no zip-offs) and closed shoes. A loose long sleeve shirt is also a good idea to protect yourself against the harsh sun. If you’ve booked a swimming ride, bring your swimmers along too.

Definitely not! Vaulting actually finds it’s origin in the cavalry and was originally used to display the physical prowess of the mounted soldier. Think of vaulting as an introduction to trick riding. Vaulting is loads of fun for folks of all ages and gender.

paragraphs: Golden Bay’s very own Vaulting Team
Did you know golden bay is home to the south island’s premier vaulting team?

The ‘Hack Vaulties’ club first came together in 2015 under the guidance of Baerbel Hack with the aim of making horse riding accessible to riders from all walks of life – regardless of their financial means or prior experience.

Since then, they have been offering the Golden Bay community awe-inspiring theatrical performances on horseback at a number of large local shows and have recently been invited to perform and host a series of vaulting workshops at Equifest – New Zealand’s largest equine event.

Vaulting is an equestrian discipline at the intersection between dance and gymnastics expressed on a moving horse. With a focus on personal development in a team environment, the Hack Vaulties club empowers young riders (from 5y/o up to 17y/o) safely develop their confidence, balance, coordination, and teamwork as they prepare for performances of breath-taking feats of gymnastic prowess, on horseback beautifully set to music.

Some of our Vaulting adventures with the team.
Balance, Horsemanship, Teamwork

Vaulting combines the athleticism of a gymnast, the expression of a dancer and the horsemanship an equestrian to deliver awe inspiring theatrical performances on a moving horse. It demands an outstanding physical condition from the vaulter, a harmonious relationship with the horse, and first-class teamwork.

Vaulting exercises include artistic mounts and dismounts, shoulder stands and handstands on the horse, carrying or lifting another vaulter, and kneeling and standing exercises which come together with music for a spectacular theatrical display.

Vaulting dates back to Greek and Roman times when soldiers – without stirrups and saddles – practiced vaulting movements as part of their military training as a way of showcasing their military prowess. Vaulters compete together in mixed gender teams – with members across a variety of ages – from as young as 5 years old to 17.
Vaulting is also documented to be the safest equestrian discipline – it is documented safer than riding bicycles, playing on playground equipment, and even playing soccer.

Special Thanks to our Sponsors who have enabled us to keep offering the life changing benefits of vaulting club to the young riders of Golden Bay Community and allowed us to showcase what a little team from a tiny town can do on the national stage too.
EMpowering young vaulters

Vaulting is an equestrian discipline at the intersection between dance and gymnastics expressed on a moving horse. With a focus on personal development in a team environment, the Hack Vaulties club empowers young riders (from 5y/o up to 17y/o) safely develop their confidence, balance, coordination, and teamwork as they prepare for performances of breath-taking feats of gymnastic prowess, on horseback beautifully set to music.

Aside from weekly training sessions to perfect the physical achievements and stunts performed on horseback, the team is also responsible for all aspects of preparation for their performances, from designing their uniform to choreographing their movements and even marketing and creative decisions.

events.ogDesc: Helping little humans achieve big outcomes with horses
paragraphs: Helping little humans achieve big outcomes with horses
Dedicated Kids holiday horse camps
Build confidence, Develop balance, improve communication and team work all disguised as fun with horses.

Our kids horse riding camps are personal development in the disguise of fun horse activities. Over the years we’ve seen the transformational experiences our young riders have as they learn transferrable skills that not only help them with riding, but also with tackling the everyday challenges of life! Our core principles of clear communication, mindfulness, understanding your personal body-space, moving with intention and problem solving are integral to our experiences on horseback. We can accommodate groups of up to 15 young riders with itineraries ranging from full day experiences through to multiday experiences tailored to your specific group needs.
Confidence, Co-ordination, Balance, rythm, Team-work
Vaulting is the perfect activity for kids of all physical abilities aged 3 and above. Our aim is to increase the awareness, building team trust, responsibility and confidence.
So much more than simply riding, vaulting combines acrobatic movements on horseback and offers an exciting yet Safe modality to teach a number of important skills and attributes.
In just a few short sessions we’ve seen complete transformations in confidence, balance, co-ordination and a true sense of belonging as we work as a team and learn how to help one another fly.
Learning to care for horses

Working alongside horses provides many opportunities for learning a number of key outcomes such as: Clear Communication, Trust, Leadership, Personal Boundaries, Empathy, Problem Solving and more!Our Horsemanship lessons start from the ground up as we teach your little humans not only how to care for the horse (brushing, grooming, feeding) but also how to develop communication skills, learning how to use their bodies and intentions as a clear form of communication in a fun and safe environment.
Learning to find your center through balanced riding.

Our horse treks are suitable for riders of all ages and experience levels and are a fun way to develop Core Strength, Balance and Co-ordination whilst practicing clear communication and riding with intent.

Our highly trained & versatile horses can adapt to all riding levels and provide a memorable experience for all. Horse treks can be adapted to suit the individual needs of your group with a focus on lessons, trekking or mounted vaulting.
Camp under the stars or book our homestead.

We offer a number of accommodation options for our Kids Camp Riding Holidays that can be tailored to your desired outcome. From Rooms in our funky horse themed homestead, to sleeping under the stars in our campground, contained sleep outs. We have everything you might need to rest your head after a day of riding!Check out the Glowworms at night, try our indoor climbing wall or go for a swing or a swim down at the lake.

paragraphs: Gift vouchers and gift cards available to purchase.
Our Gift Cards can be purchased online and credited with any amount to be put toward rides/accommodation/lessons/vaulting experiences with Hack N Stay.

Once purchased, the gift card can either be emailed immediately to the recipient (great for a last minute but thoughtful gift) or alternatively we can hand fill one of our Hack Farm Vouchers on site and mail the physical copy to the recipient. If you’d like us to mail the Gift Voucher, please send us an email with the Gift Card’s unique number and the recipients name & address.

Simply follow the link below to purchase a gift card for any amount. Use your credit card at check out and then choose to either email the gift voucher immediately to the recipient with a little message, or alternatively flick us an email with with the recipients name and postal address and we can mail them a physical copy of the voucher.
To use your voucher, simply click on “book now” on any on of our rides/rooms/lessons and fill out your details.

Directly under Contact & Payment, you will find a button to “Apply Gift Card” Click on this and then type in the Voucher Number from your gift Card.The Gift Card amount will then automatically be deducted from the booking total and you can either pay the difference, or the credit will be stored under the same number ready to go towards your next visit with Hack n Stay.

privacy.ogDesc: Your Privacy Is important to us
h2s: CCPA Privacy Rights (Do Not Sell My Personal Information)
paragraphs: Your Privacy Is important to us

At Hack Farm, accessible from https://hackfarm.co.nz, one of our main priorities is the privacy of our visitors. This Privacy Policy document contains types of information that is collected and recorded by Hack Farm and how we use it.
If you have additional questions or require more information about our Privacy Policy, do not hesitate to contact us.

This Privacy Policy applies only to our online activities and is valid for visitors to our website with regards to the information that they shared and/or collect in Hack Farm. This policy is not applicable to any information collected offline or via channels other than this website. Our Privacy Policy was created with the help of the Privacy Policy Generator.
By using our website, you hereby consent to our Privacy Policy and agree to its terms.
The personal information that you are asked to provide, and the reasons why you are asked to provide it, will be made clear to you at the point we ask you to provide your personal information.

If you contact us directly, we may receive additional information about you such as your name, email address, phone number, the contents of the message and/or attachments you may send us, and any other information you may choose to provide.
When you register for an Account, we may ask for your contact information, including items such as name, company name, address, email address, and telephone number.
We use the information we collect in various ways, including to:

Hack Farm follows a standard procedure of using log files. These files log visitors when they visit websites. All hosting companies do this and a part of hosting services’ analytics. The information collected by log files include internet protocol (IP) addresses, browser type, Internet Service Provider (ISP), date and time stamp, referring/exit pages, and possibly the number of clicks. These are not linked to any information that is personally identifiable. The purpose of the information is for analyzing trends, administering the site, tracking users’ movement on the website, and gathering demographic information.

Like any other website, Hack Farm uses ‘cookies’. These cookies are used to store information including visitors’ preferences, and the pages on the website that the visitor accessed or visited. The information is used to optimize the users’ experience by customizing our web page content based on visitors’ browser type and/or other information.
For more general information on cookies, please read “What Are Cookies”.
You may consult this list to find the Privacy Policy for each of the advertising partners of Hack Farm.

Third-party ad servers or ad networks uses technologies like cookies, JavaScript, or Web Beacons that are used in their respective advertisements and links that appear on Hack Farm, which are sent directly to users’ browser. They automatically receive your IP address when this occurs. These technologies are used to measure the effectiveness of their advertising campaigns and/or to personalize the advertising content that you see on websites that you visit.
Note that Hack Farm has no access to or control over these cookies that are used by third-party advertisers.

Hack Farm’s Privacy Policy does not apply to other advertisers or websites. Thus, we are advising you to consult the respective Privacy Policies of these third-party ad servers for more detailed information. It may include their practices and instructions about how to opt-out of certain options.

You can choose to disable cookies through your individual browser options. To know more detailed information about cookie management with specific web browsers, it can be found at the browsers’ respective websites.
Under the CCPA, among other rights, California consumers have the right to:
Request that a business that collects a consumer’s personal data disclose the categories and specific pieces of personal data that a business has collected about consumers.
Request that a business delete any personal data about the consumer that a business has collected.
Request that a business that sells a consumer’s personal data, not sell the consumer’s personal data.
If you make a request, we have one month to respond to you. If you would like to exercise any of these rights, please contact us.
We would like to make sure you are fully aware of all of your data protection rights. Every user is entitled to the following:
The right to access – You have the right to request copies of your personal data. We may charge you a small fee for this service.

The right to rectification – You have the right to request that we correct any information you believe is inaccurate. You also have the right to request that we complete the information you believe is incomplete.
The right to erasure – You have the right to request that we erase your personal data, under certain conditions.
The right to restrict processing – You have the right to request that we restrict the processing of your personal data, under certain conditions.
The right to object to processing – You have the right to object to our processing of your personal data, under certain conditions.
The right to data portability – You have the right to request that we transfer the data that we have collected to another organization, or directly to you, under certain conditions.
If you make a request, we have one month to respond to you. If you would like to exercise any of these rights, please contact us.
Another part of our priority is adding protection for children while using the internet. We encourage parents and guardians to observe, participate in, and/or monitor and guide their online activity.

Hack Farm does not knowingly collect any Personal Identifiable Information from children under the age of 13. If you think that your child provided this kind of information on our website, we strongly encourage you to contact us immediately and we will do our best efforts to promptly remove such information from our records.

horses.title: Brunner
h2s: Nickname | Beautiful Brunner the One Eyed Wonder
paragraphs: A bit about me:

I had an accident when I was baby and damaged one of my eyes. Bumma, some mistakes are we doing just once, eh? I am very elegant. I lower my head a bit more to check things out and love to go for a lovely ride along the sands. Crawling over the rocks is not what I like most, a roll in the sand instead would be juuuuust fine. I even don’t mind if you sit on me :) Name: Beautiful Brunner Breed: Appaloosa...

horses.title: Arnie
paragraphs: A bit about me:

I’m an Austrian, born 2015, isn’t that all you need to know? Some say I am the cutest here and I can’t argue with that. But sometimes they forget how smart I am as well… there’s no fence or gate that can hold me. I am still pretty young and need to learn a few things (i.e. not to roll in the sand with a rider on board). However that should not be a problem. I’m an Aaaaustrian remember.
